meta.variable: codeAct.enabled (code.execute disclosed and callable) — everything else identical
meta.dataset: src/eval/codeactTasks.ts (10 tasks, deterministic fake incident window)
meta.eligibility: two or more deterministic read-only lookups whose results must be combined, or one large result whose useful content is an aggregate
notes: SIMULATED PROVIDER: tokens and cost are unknown (null); estimated_prompt_tokens is chars/4, not a provider count.
Adoption is by construction (the policy uses CodeAct for every eligible task when offered).
The policy replays the same reference plan in both variants and never reformulates a query to avoid truncation; truncation effects are an upper bound for a naive direct strategy.
This is NOT a live-model or production result (verification level ≤ 3).

usage_outcomes.label: observational: adoption is chosen by the agent, not randomized
